, Reason for Mistake: The Planner reframed the target as “Carolingian Latin (Carolingian minuscule)” and pursued script-focused details, conflating script with language and over-specifying the era’s Latin. The question asks what the version of Latin used in Charlemagne’s time was later known as—simply “Medieval Latin.” This misdirection led to a non-exact final answer instead of the expected “Medieval Latin.”
